$comment_emnapi: @emnapi/core and @emnapi/runtime below are used by NONE of our code. @napi-rs/wasm-runtime@1.2.0 — bundled inside the wasm32-wasi fallback binaries of tailwind-oxide and the eslint resolver — peers on @emnapi/core@^2.0.0-alpha.3, and npm will not auto-install a PRERELEASE peer. So they never landed in package-lock.json, and `npm ci` on a clean Linux runner rejected the whole tree as out of sync ('Missing: @emnapi/core@2.0.0-alpha.3 from lock file') before running a single test. Declaring them forces them into the lock on every platform. Drop them once @napi-rs/wasm-runtime ships a stable 2.x peer range.
